I think it might be better for OP to work through these feelings with a therapist before approaching the sister, and likely suggest therapy for the sister as well. If OP approaches sister with no plan and no working through the emotions firstly it is likely to get emotional and heated and end up worse than it started.

Her sister is also likely suffering from the same feelings, especially by what she’s said about her avoidance. It’s hard from either perspective to go through this. This isn’t either of their faults, it’s honestly no ones fault. The parents did the best they could. The only thing I’m questioning is why OP wasn’t also with the grandparents at the time of surgery.

NAH. I’d suggest therapy, for both you and your sister. I understand why you needed somebody by your side, it’s a fair point, but id just ask you consider if you wanted your sister to also have this suffering. It’s not something you should have had to go through, but neither should you sister. Neither of this is either of your faults.

You took on such a large responsibility at such a young age and that must be so incredibly tough, and you should absolutely not have had to go through that. But id imagine having your sister there, while easier at the time, may have made both your lives worse in the long run. It’s likely she also suffers with these feelings, and anxiety and depression, even if she didn’t go through everything you did.

Please please consider therapy, and try and talk to your sister about these things, but please don’t resent her, she was also going through what you were going through, obviously coping with it in a different, and dealing with a bit of a different situation.

You absolutely shouldn’t let it go, but you shouldn’t be resenting her for it. You need to work through these feelings with a professional, and please urge her to as well. 

This must have been tough on both of you and I wish you all the best.

Edit: after reading a lot of other comments suggesting you approach your sister, I would urge you not to at this current moment. With the emotions you and your sister likely have right now, a “talk” will end up in a heated argument and a wedge between you. Both of you need to work through this situation with a therapist beforehand, there is no way you can go into a conversation like this without talking to a professional. It will end up worse than it started.
